predictions.articleTitle: South Africa vs Kenya Prediction & Match Analysis: Can McCarthy's Block Halt Bafana? — Scoreline Preview
predictions.coreRecommendation: South Africa hold superior Group D firepower, home momentum, and Elo class to defeat Kenya in regulation time while keeping total scoring contained.
possibilityAssessment: South Africa Home Win driven by 3.50 Group D goals per match and returning core depth (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Under 2.5 Goals supported by Kenya's compact away defending and two-match scoreless run (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
South Africa clean sheet hedge anchored by 0.34 decayed goals conceded across five recent games (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Mosimane's unbeaten Bafana attack tests McCarthy's compact, already-qualified Kenya block.

spf.comment: South Africa's 3.50 qualifying goals per match, 197-point Elo edge, and superior defensive solidity project a 2:0 or 1:0 home victory.

over_under.comment: Removing the 5:0 Eritrea outlier leaves tight recent scoring profiles, with Kenya scoreless in two straight games and South Africa missing 50.0% of big chances.

score.comment: 2:0 (16.2%) and 1:0 (14.4%) are the top Poisson matrix outcomes and align with South Africa's home control against a low Kenyan block.

goals.comment: Adjusted goal expectancy around 2.20 concentrates probability mass on 2 or 1 total goals.

bqc.comment: South Africa led at half-time in both qualifiers while Kenya trailed in both, though Kenya's low block could delay the breakthrough until after the interval.
